calculators.title: Stakeholder risk score
calculators.description: Weight stakeholder impact, likelihood, and severity to see where ethical accountability pressure is highest.
calculators.formulaLabel: Risk score = stakeholder impact x likelihood x severity

graphs.title: Stakeholder balance map
graphs.description: Shift pressure between shareholders, workers, customers, and community to expose the ethical trade-off profile of a decision.

calculators.title: Ethical decision balance
calculators.description: Compare principle, consequence, and community weightings to rehearse how different ethical lenses change a recommendation.
calculators.formulaLabel: Decision score = principle + consequence + community alignment
